answer: A delta counter fixes each claimant's rank when its bridge application is sealed. Rank m must link m new spans into the network, and every span needs pulse signatures from m different inspectors. Inspectors may sign only one span per epoch, while reused nonces or timestamps invalidate the whole chain. For k claimants the protocol consequently consumes 1²+2²+...+k² = k(k+1)(2k+1)/6 distinct inspections. A farm gains no economy from shared bridges, cloned pulse trains, or pooled inspector signatures.
